name: Onboard paying clients with Stripe, Google Drive, a Docs contract, Trello and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Onboard paying clients with Stripe, Google Drive, a Docs contract, Trello and Gmail

### How it works
1. A paid Stripe Checkout (or the internal form for bank transfers) starts the onboarding, once per payment.
2. A client folder with subfolders is created in Google Drive, and your contract template is copied and filled in.
3. The contract is shared for comments, and the assets subfolder is shared so the client can upload files.
4. A Trello board is copied from your template, the client is logged in Google Sheets, and the client gets a welcome email with every next step.
5. The brief form saves answers as a Google Doc in the client folder. Clients who have not sent it get up to two reminders.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Add **Stripe** (with the webhook signing secret), **Google Drive**, **Google Docs**, **Google Sheets**, **Trello**, **Gmail** and **Basic Auth** credentials.
- [ ] Create a contract template in Google Docs with placeholders like `[[client_company]]` and `[[amount]]` (see **Fill Contract**), and a Trello template board.
- [ ] Create a spreadsheet with empty `Clients` and `Error Log` tabs and select it in every Google Sheets node.
- [ ] Edit **Onboarding Settings**: folder, template IDs and texts.

### Customization
Change the subfolders, packages and reminder timing in **Onboarding Settings**.

## Receive payments and briefs
Stripe, a transfer form, the brief form and the daily run.

## Check the payment
Paid, and only once per payment.

## Create the client folders
A client folder with your subfolders.

## Prepare and share the contract
Template copy, filled in, shared for comments.

## Set up the project
Trello board from your template, row in Clients.

## Welcome the client
Next steps for the client, links for the team.

## Match the brief to a client
The hidden client ID from the email link.

## Save the brief
A Google Doc in the client folder.

## Remind about the brief
Up to two reminders, the last one copies the team.

## Catch workflow errors
Builds an incident report from any failed execution.

## Send the alert
Emails it, or logs it to the Error Log tab.

nodes.name: Stripe Payment
nodes.notes: Stripe Checkout or Payment Links. Add a "company" custom field and a "package" metadata value to the Payment Link. After the first activation, copy the endpoint signing secret from Stripe (Developers → Webhooks) into the credential, so only signed events are accepted.

parameters.formDescription: For clients who paid by bank transfer or invoice. Starts the same onboarding as a Stripe payment.

values.placeholder: Bank transfer ID or invoice number

values.formSubmittedText: Onboarding started. The client receives the welcome email in a minute.

nodes.name: Manual Payment Form
nodes.notes: Internal form, protected with Basic Auth. The payment reference prevents double onboarding.

parameters.formDescription: Help us start right. This takes about 10 minutes.

values.fieldLabel: Websites or brands you like, and why
Content and brand assets you already have

values.formSubmittedText: Thank you! Your brief is with our team. We will review it before the kick-off call.

nodes.name: Project Brief Form
nodes.notes: Public form. The welcome email links to it with ?client_id=..., which fills the hidden field.

nodes.name: Every Day at 09:00
nodes.notes: Brief reminders. Uses the workflow time zone.

assignments.name: subfolders
assignments.value: 01 Contract & Invoices, 02 Brief & Assets, 03 Work in Progress, 04 Deliverables

nodes.name: Onboarding Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. One place for every setting. brief_form_url is built from this n8n's address; replace it if the form runs behind another domain.

nodes.name: Normalize Client
nodes.notes: Stripe amounts are in cents, except for zero-decimal currencies.

nodes.name: Only Paid
nodes.notes: Bank debits and other delayed methods arrive unpaid first; their "async payment succeeded" event starts the onboarding.

nodes.name: Skip Repeat Payments
nodes.notes: Stripe resends events, and a transfer may be entered twice. Each payment onboards once.

nodes.name: Create Client Folder
nodes.notes: Inside your Clients folder (clients_folder_id).

nodes.name: Copy Contract
nodes.notes: A copy of your Google Docs contract template.

nodes.name: Fill Contract
nodes.notes: Replaces [[client_company]], [[client_name]], [[client_email]], [[package]], [[amount]], [[start_date]], [[contract_date]] and [[agency_name]] in the copy.

options.emailMessage: ={{ "Your contract with " + $('Onboarding Settings').first().json.agency_name + ". Comments are welcome." }}

nodes.name: Share Contract
nodes.notes: The client can read and comment. Google requires a notification email for addresses without a Google account. If sharing fails, onboarding goes on and the team email says so.

options.emailMessage: Upload your logo, brand files and content here.

nodes.name: Share Brief Folder
nodes.notes: Only this subfolder is shared, so the client can upload assets.

parameters.name: ={{ $('Normalize Client').first().json.company + ' · ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.package }}
parameters.description: ={{ 'Client ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.client_id + ' · ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.contact_name + ' <' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.email + '> · start ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.start_date + '\nDrive: ' + $('Collect Folders').first().json.client_folder_url }}

nodes.name: Create Project Board
nodes.notes: A copy of your template board, with its lists and cards (your standard project checklist).

nodes.name: Client Row
nodes.notes: Field names = Clients sheet headers. They are created on an empty tab.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Welcome to ' + $('Onboarding Settings').first().json.agency_name + ': your next steps' }}

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email
nodes.notes: Contract, brief form, shared folder and kick-off link in one email.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'New client: ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.company + ' · ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.package + ' · ' + $('Normalize Client').first().json.amount_text }}

nodes.name: Known Client?
nodes.notes: A brief without a valid link still reaches the team, marked as unmatched.

nodes.name: Create Brief Doc
nodes.notes: In the client folder.

parameters.subject: ={{ ($('Create Brief Doc').isExecuted ? 'Brief received: ' : '[Unmatched brief] ') + ($('Format Brief').first().json.company || 'unknown company') }}

nodes.name: Plan Brief Reminders
nodes.notes: The last reminder copies the team, so someone can call the client.

nodes.name: Loop Brief Reminders
nodes.notes: One email per pass, so a retried send never repeats another client's reminder.

nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Internal error workflow: n8n starts here when any production execution of THIS workflow fails (and Settings → Error workflow is empty).

nodes.name: Alert Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. Who gets incident alerts. Comma-separate multiple emails.

error_message

nodes.name: Build Incident Report
nodes.notes: Normalises the Error Trigger payload (execution errors and trigger errors have different shapes) into one incident record.

nodes.name: Email Alert
nodes.notes: Primary alert. Email is independent of the services this workflow calls, so their outage cannot silence the alert. Retries 3× / 5 s, then the fallback runs.

nodes.name: Error Log Row
nodes.notes: Shapes the Error Log columns and renames the email failure reason. Keeps a field called 'error' away from the Sheets node: Retry On Fail treats an output item with 'error' as a failed try and would append the row again.

nodes.name: Fallback · Log to Error Sheet
nodes.notes: Only runs when the email alert failed after 3 tries. Appends the incident to the 'Error Log' tab; the header row is created on first use. If this fails too, the error run shows as failed in Executions.
